title: Solana Helius live read-only source
objective: Add the smallest production Helius implementation needed for one Solana-only live smoke analysis. It reads its credential only at runtime, fails closed when unavailable, applies a fixed request budget, rate limit and timeout, preserves fixture operation, and never writes to a production database.
forbidden_actions: Do not print, store, commit or record credentials, bearer values, raw provider payloads, or credential-bearing URLs.
Do not fall back to a public RPC endpoint when the runtime credential is absent or invalid.
Do not activate BSC, Robinhood, scheduler, cron, background loops, or automated token discovery.
Do not write to a production database.
Do not call any provider except Helius from the live data source.
